visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with vibrant pink, wavy hair smiles at the camera indoors, wearing a light blue sweatshirt with an alien graphic. (2) She appears in a different indoor setting with wooden walls, wearing her hair in two braids tucked into a black knitted bonnet. (3) A screen recording of a mobile application named 'Hot Pepper Beauty' displays a hair salon profile for 'hair studio Zen ~advance~', showing reviews and menu items. (4) Back in a salon setting, a female stylist in the background begins preparing the woman's hair while she wears a protective cape. (5) A close-up view of a professional hair color chart shows various swatches of red, pink, and brown hair colors. (6) The stylist applies bright pink dye to the woman's hair; one shot uses a facial distortion filter for comedic effect. (7) The woman lies back at a salon washbasin with a white cloth covering her eyes while her hair is rinsed. (8) The stylist blow-dries the woman's now deep-purple hair and uses scissors to trim the bangs while the woman records the process in a mirror. (9) A title card with a 'SpongeBob' style background appears with the text 'A FEW MOMENTS LATER'. (10) The woman is shown outdoors on a sunny street with her hair styled in soft pinkish-purple waves, wearing a beige puffer coat. (11) A Casio calculator shows the number '10100' on its screen, placed near a wallet on a counter. (12) Shots of a building exterior with signage for 'hair studio Zen advance' and 'KIMONO RENTAL'. (13) An Instagram profile for '村上 杏佳' is shown on a smartphone screen. (14) The woman is back indoors, waving and running her hands through her finished hair with a satisfied expression.

(5) [Subtitle]: 開始啦!!. (6) [Subtitle]: 設計師會先跟你細心討論髮色 雖然都是日文 討論完後就開始染頭髮!!. (7) [Subtitle]: 嗯?這個亮粉色?? 有點像Rumi (獵魔女團). (8) [Subtitle]: 洗頭中.... (9) [Subtitle]: 洗完套頭就來吹頭髮啦! 接下來就是最期待的剪頭髮. (10) [Variety]: ???. (11) [Subtitle]: 染、剪、護、洗 這樣竟然只要2000台幣! (10100日圓約等於2024台幣). (12) [Subtitle]: 我來的是東本願寺對面的 hair studio Zen advance. (13) [Subtitle]: 設計師是村上杏佳. (14) [Subtitle]: 你們覺得好看嗎 一起來日本用頭髮吧!

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main female creator and 1 female stylist clearly visible in the salon scenes.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with trendy dyed hair (initially pink, then purple-pink), wearing casual clothing like sweatshirts and puffer coats.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video transitions between a modern home interior, a professional hair salon with styling stations and mirrors, a busy urban street in Japan, and digital screenshots of apps/social media.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female Mandarin narration begins over an upbeat, major-key electronic pop track with a steady dance beat. (2) A digital 'click' SFX triggers as the narrator explains using a mobile app, followed by a quick 'whoosh' transition. (3) Low-volume Japanese chatter from a female stylist is heard in the background while the narrator continues her fast-paced delivery. (4) A comedic, pitch-shifted vocal filter effect occurs briefly during the dyeing segment, accompanied by a cartoonish 'boing' sound. (5) During the hair washing phase, the BGM changes to a female voice singing traditional Chinese-style lyrics ('掀起你的蓋頭來') in a playful arrangement. (6) Sharp metallic 'snip' SFX are timed with the visual of scissors cutting hair, punctuating the narration. (7) Faint outdoor ambient hum and distant traffic noise are audible as the narrator reveals the final hairstyle outdoors. (8) Several high-pitched digital 'beep' or 'click' SFX play as a calculator is used, leading into the final high-energy call to action with the original upbeat music.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Reason -> Method -> Process -> Result -> Cost Analysis -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A travel-focused beauty vlog demonstrating the affordability and process of getting a professional hair makeover in Japan. It uses a step-by-step narrative to inform viewers about app reservations and salon quality at a low price point.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Detailed mention of the salon name, price, app used for booking, and specific stylist recommendation.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively combines digital interface screen captures with real-world vlogging to create a comprehensive 'how-to' guide for international viewers.
